model: Samsung 990 PRO 2 TB, no heatsink, 2022 review sample
frame: +X extends from x=0 at the M.2 mating edge to x=80 at the mounting-notch end. +Y is upward in the top view, y=0..22 nominal width. Component side faces +Z. Bottom features use the same physical XY system.
measurement: The KitGuru 2048 px top view is perspectively rectified to the nominal 80 x 22 mm bounding rectangle. Estimated XY accuracy 0.2-0.6 mm. Package and SMD heights are illustrative estimates. Verified visible NAND markings take precedence over differing text transcription. The exposed metal controller lid is modeled by its main silhouette.

bottom.label: Regulatory sticker with copper foil
bottom.geometry: Perspective-aligned approximate sticker corners, slightly rounded in original. SAMSUNG SSD to the left of this smaller regulatory sticker is separately printed on the black reverse.

bottom_observation: In the KitGuru rear photograph only the rectangular regulatory sticker covers the central-to-right area. Both ends outside the sticker show the black board, mounting rims, the mating edge, and opposite face of the ten plated contacts. Do not infer internal routing, unobserved copper or packages under the sticker.

top.method: Counts from photographs, stripe centers fitted to a uniform pitch per segment. No electrical assignment.

bottom.method: Counts from photographs, stripe centers fitted to a uniform pitch per segment. No electrical assignment.

detail_notes: Small packages were digitized from the top photograph. Their classifications are estimates from package color and termination style, not an electrical BOM. The two exposed ICs alongside the DRAM and the small ICs beside the controller are retained; exact functions unknown. Selected faint outer-layer traces record visible fan-out direction and approximate bends, without assigning any signal or endpoint. Ten upper-right plated contacts are visible on both faces; list contains the top view once to avoid duplicating board drill holes. The two dense bands adjacent to the controller were re-read in the source raster. Where only bright metal terminations are resolved, individual solder_lands reproduce the optical centers; no hidden resistor/capacitor bodies or values are assigned to these sites. Arrays are partial feature counts, not a production BOM.
clearance_adjustments: Outer silhouettes from the slanted edge of BGA bodies and bright SMD solder fillets have 1-2 px localization uncertainty. Six tiny parts along the upper edge of the two NAND BGAs were shifted outward <=0.15 mm, the width and position of T_B_mlcc_23 were refined between adjacent packages and T_B_resistor_05 shifted 0.045 mm, using the visible inter-package dark gaps. No coordinates are factory land-pattern or tolerance data.
through_hole_evidence: The two aligned 2 x 5 arrays have copper annuli and a recessed, reflective center on both faces; drilled plated-through geometry is the reconstruction used. The photos cannot establish the hidden barrel continuity, diameter tolerance, connectivity, or electrical purpose.
